text: [dry, confessing to a friend] I bought the Halloween candy a week early.
[sly] Monday, I had one. Quality control.
[guilty, justifying] Wednesday, a few. Small ones don't count.
[haunted, slower] Friday... I don't remember Friday.
[resigned] So I did what every adult does.
[whispering] Lights off. On the floor. Not home.
[flat, matter-of-fact, child] He's on the FLOOR.
[panicked, shouting from the floor] NOBODY'S HOME!
[flat] Ten minutes later, the ghost left something on the mat.
